Example coherence numbers used by the other diagrams: f01, T1, and T2*.
Not a measured device. The page mode selects the matching table.

## Screen

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
from review import display_figure, for_renderings, table

for_renderings(lambda appearance: display_figure(table(appearance, "screen"), config={"displaylogo": False}))
```

## Print

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
for_renderings(lambda appearance: display_figure(table(appearance, "print"), config={"staticPlot": True, "displayModeBar": False}))
```
